content:
We are back with our weekly update, tracking what new additions are available this week at the Apple Certified Refurbished Store. This week's highlights include the MacBook Neo, new configurations of the MacBook Air, and the Apple Watch Ultra 3.

The Apple Certified Refurbished Store is an excellent way to purchase directly from Apple's official website while enjoying discounts of up to 15%.

Here is what you need to know:

  • Outstanding quality, attractive prices
  • Undergoes a rigorous refurbishment process before being sold
  • Backed by Apple's one-year limited warranty
  • Covered by Apple's 14-day return policy
  • Optional purchase of AppleCare product protection
  • Engraving and gift wrapping services are not available for refurbished products

We track every addition and price drop at the Apple Certified Refurbished Store so you don't have to. Stock changes rapidly, and the purpose of this article is to keep you informed about currently available products so you can snag them before they sell out.

Mac computers

For me, the MacBook Neo and MacBook Air pricing remains the standout deals this round. Both are great choices for those entering the Apple ecosystem for the first time or upgrading to an Apple Silicon model.

MacBook Neo

  • MacBook Neo with 256GB storage: $599 (originally $799 new)
  • MacBook Neo with 512GB storage and Touch ID: $679 (originally $799 new)

MacBook Air

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 512GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,099 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 1TB storage and 16GB memory: $1,529 (originally $1,799 new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 2TB storage and 16GB memory: $1,949 (originally $2,299 new)

iMac

  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 256GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,269 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 512GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,439 (originally $1,699 new)

Studio Display

We first reported weeks ago that the refurbished store had the Studio Display XDR available. As always, stock changes rapidly, and the Studio Display XDR is no exception. As of today, only two configurations remain in stock:

  • Studio Display XDR with standard glass and tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $2,799 (originally $3,299 new)
  • Studio Display XDR with nano-texture glass and tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $3,059 (originally $3,599 new)

Apple TV 4K

The much sought-after base-model Apple TV 4K is back in stock this week, while the long-available higher-end version with Ethernet connectivity also has inventory. The base model typically sells out quickly—if you're interested, don't hesitate.

  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) with 64GB storage, Wi-Fi: $169 (originally $199 new)
  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) with 128GB storage, Wi-Fi and Ethernet: $209 (originally $249 new)

Apple Watch Ultra

I wear the Apple Watch Ultra 3 every day, and if you've been thinking about joining me, the refurbished store has some pretty compelling deals this week:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm Black Titanium case with Black Ocean band: $679 (originally $799 new)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm Natural Titanium case with Anchor Blue Ocean band: $679 (originally $799 new)

As always, to stay on top of the latest Apple deals throughout the week, visit 9to5Toys.
